nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a complete nontrivially normed field whose norm is ultrametric, with algebraic closure $\overline{K}$, and let $\alpha, \beta \in \overline{K}$. If $\alpha$ is the closest conjugate to $\beta$ and $\alpha$ is separable over $K$, then $K(\alpha) \subseteq K(\beta)$.
nodes.title: Krasner's lemma for closest conjugates

nodes.title: Closest conjugate roots of nearby monic polynomials

nodes.title: Approximation by irreducible separable polynomials over a dense field

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a complete nontrivially normed field whose norm is ultrametric, and let $f \in K[X]$ be monic, irreducible and separable. Then there is a real $\delta > 0$ such that every monic $g \in K[X]$ with $\lVert f - g \rVert_1 < \delta$, where $\lVert \cdot \rVert_1$ is the $\ell^1$ norm (the sum of the norms of the coefficients), is irreducible and separable.
nodes.title: Small monic perturbations stay irreducible and separable

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a normed field with algebraic closure $\overline{K}$, and let $\lVert \cdot \rVert$ be the spectral norm on $\overline{K}$ over $K$. For $\alpha, \beta \in \overline{K}$, $\alpha$ is the closest conjugate to $\beta$ if $\lVert \beta - \alpha \rVert < \lVert \beta - \sigma(\alpha) \rVert$ for every $K$-algebra automorphism $\sigma$ of $\overline{K}$ with $\sigma(\alpha) \ne \alpha$.
nodes.title: Closest conjugate

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a complete nontrivially normed field whose norm is ultrametric, with algebraic closure $\overline{K}$, let $\lVert \cdot \rVert$ be the spectral norm on $\overline{K}$ over $K$, and let $\alpha, \beta, \alpha' \in \overline{K}$. If $\alpha$ is the closest conjugate to $\beta$ and $\alpha' \ne \alpha$ is a conjugate of $\alpha$ over $K$, then $\lVert \alpha - \beta \rVert < \lVert \alpha - \alpha' \rVert$.
nodes.title: Closest conjugates satisfy Krasner's hypothesis

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
